newsitem.title: USA: Forest Oil to up capital spending in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Forest Oil to up capital spending in 1997.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp said Thursday it plans to increase its capital expenditure budget to about $115 million in 1997 from about $75 million in 1996.
The company said it expected to fund most of the 1997 capital expenditure with cash flow.
Both spending figures exclude property acquisitions, the company said.
"We have numerous investment opportunities in 1997 in both the United States and Canada, many of which result from our successful 1996 drilling program," Chief Executive Officer Robert Boswell said.
The company said its greatest area of focus would be the Gulf of Mexico, where it expects to drill about 20 wells in 1997.
It said it also expects to increase onshore activity, focusing on U.S. western sedimentary basin.
